scheme_name: Industrial R&D Promotion Programme: Recognition Of In-House R&D Units
other_conditions: The applicant must be a company registered under the Companies Act, 1956 or 2013
The company must have completed three financial years after formation
The company should have a regular source of income for at least the last two years
The company must be engaged in manufacturing, production, technical services, or contract research with independent research infrastructure
The R&D unit(s) must not be located in residential areas and must be on‑premises authorized by the central or state government
Minimum area for R&D activities must be at least 1000 sq ft
The R&D unit(s) must be functional at the time of application with well‑defined, time‑bound programmes
Biotech start‑up must conduct high‑end research with potential IP generation and revenue
Biotech start‑up must have qualified R&D manpower and basic infrastructure
Biotech start‑up must provide details of collaborations, agreements or MOUs with incubator centres or technology parks
Biotech start‑up must submit a list of biotechnology‑based project proposals approved for Government of India funding
The company must have a long‑term R&D policy displayed prominently in the R&D unit(s)
R&D activities must be separate from routine production and quality‑control activities
The R&D unit must have separate, identifiable infrastructure (may be in a separate building, floor or room)
Qualified staff exclusively engaged in R&D must be headed by a full‑time qualified R&D person with direct access to the Chief Executive or Board of Directors
The number of R&D personnel must be commensurate with the company’s overall S&T manpower size
Separate books of accounts must be maintained for all R&D expenditures, reflected in the annual report and statement of accounts
benefits_summary: Recognised in‑house R&D units become eligible for government fiscal incentives and can receive research funding from multiple ministries and agencies where DSIR recognition is a prerequisite.
documents_required: Fully filled‑in application form (signed by Managing Director or any Director on Board)
Requisite annexures in PDF format (single attachment <20 MB)
Proof of authorization for the R&D premises
Documents/details of collaborations, agreements and MOUs with Incubator Centres or Technology Parks
List of Biotechnology‑based project proposals submitted/approved for Government of India funding
